transcript.text: Salieri. I have received letters — more than one — alleging that you have used your position as Kapellmeister to suppress the works of rival composers and to block appointments to the Court that do not serve your personal interests. These are serious charges for a man in your position. I value your service, but I must hear your account. Explain yourself.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

Ah, Your Majesty, I am deeply troubled to hear such accusations raised against me. Allow me to address these concerns with the utmost sincerity and honesty.

As Kapellmeister, it is my duty to ensure that the musical standards at the court are maintained at the highest level. When it comes to selecting composers for prestigious positions, I always prioritize merit and talent above personal interests. It is true that I have voiced my opinions on certain candidates, including young Mozart, whose skills I have acknowledged but whose character and conduct I have found wanting for such a position of great responsibility. My intention has always been to uphold the integrity of our musical tradition and to protect the reputation of our court.

Regarding the cancellation of rival operas, I must clarify that such decisions are made based on artistic considerations and the overall coherence of the season's repertoire. It is not my intention to stifle competition or to promote my own works at the expense of others. My actions are guided by a sincere dedication to the art of music and a desire to see it flourish in Vienna.

I humbly ask for Your Majesty's understanding and trust in my intentions. I am committed to serving the court with loyalty and integrity, and I am ready to accept any guidance or correction you may deem necessary to address these concerns. May the music that brings us together continue to inspire and uplift our spirits under your wise and benevolent rule.

Furthermore, the reports concerning the suppression of rival operas trouble me greatly. Artistic considerations, you say, but who ultimately determines these, if not those in positions such as yours? Without transparency, such decisions risk the misconstruction of influence and self-interest. Explain further, how these "artistic considerations" and frameworks were applied, and what measures you will take to assure that your authority is not seen as benefiting only few.

I assure you that my decisions were guided by what I believed to be in the best interest of the court's artistic program as a whole. In the future, I will implement clearer criteria and decision-making frameworks to ensure that all selections and cancellations are made with the utmost fairness and impartiality.
